# java-guardrails 0.3.3

ArchUnit measurement and the copied `NoCyclesTest` now handle modules whose classes all live in
one package. Every imported package participates, including the root package, so root-to-child
package cycles are detected too. Class cycles still fail independently. Missing or empty compiled
main classes stop measurement; the copied test retains its separate nonempty-import assertion.
No global empty-rule override is needed.

The ArchUnit falsifier can plant both classes in a module's sole package. Real Maven regressions
cover acyclic single-package modules, class cycles, root-to-child package cycles, disabled rules,
empty imports and restoration of planted sources.

For existing copied tests, replace the old root-prefix package rule with the template's `PACKAGE`
assignment, retain the class rule and `importsSomething` test, apply the target's formatter and
falsify again. Updating the kit does not rewrite tests already copied into a target.

The README now recommends global `npx skills add ... -g` installation for all-projects use and
also explains project scope. Refresh with `add` using the same scope and agents as installation;
the tested CLI's `update` command can leave an agent's copied skill stale. The instructions include
the supported Node requirement.

The 0.3.2 changelog entry is dated on the default branch; its existing tag remains unchanged.
Release validation now requires exactly one valid dated changelog heading for the version being
tagged and rejects `Unreleased` before creating a tag.
